title: session.create (publisher → relay)
description: First message of a new publisher: open a session and receive a code (docs/protocol.md §4.1). Carries no token — the publisherToken is issued in session.created (ADR 0008 errata).

preferredCode.description: Code the publisher previously held, or null. Granted only if free and well-formed; a malformed value is ignored, not rejected (§4.1).

not.$comment: §4.1 / ADR 0008 errata: session.create has no token field.
